title: What users complain about, by product
brief:
Our product lead, Marta, is preparing next quarter's roadmap for an AI assistant and asked for a one-page evidence brief on what users of the two leading assistants complain about, so we can decide where to compete.

You have two small tables in data/. app-reviews.csv gives, for Claude and ChatGPT, the share of the app's low-star app-store reviews that mention each topic, with the number of low-star reviews behind each app. hn-topics.csv gives, for Anthropic and OpenAI, the share of negative Hacker News comments on each topic. These two files carry no source ids; name them as "App-store low-star review sample (RichView flagship example)" and "Hacker News negative-comment sample (RichView flagship example)".

The question: on which topics do the two products differ most, and does the picture agree between app reviews and Hacker News? Marta wants three numbers in the report: the topic with the widest gap between the two apps in the app reviews and that gap in percentage points; the same for Hacker News; and how many more low-star reviews Claude has than ChatGPT.

Audience: Marta and two engineers, five minutes of reading. Use at least three different chart types, include a table of every topic with both sources side by side, and name the data source under every chart.

figures.describe: widest app-review gap (Refusals, Claude minus ChatGPT, points)
widest Hacker News gap (Coding, Anthropic minus OpenAI, points)
